final-01.prompt: Use case: creature design vote for a children's reading game. Image 1 shows the exact species and painting style: left a KANGAROO, middle a LION, right a HUMMINGBIRD. Keep these species exactly; do not mix animals, no koala, no penguin, no bear. Create a NEW landscape 3:2 sheet: STRICT grid of THREE columns by TWO rows, SIX equal square cells, thin light separators, warm ivory background, NO text, captions, letters or numbers anywhere. Painterly premium children's fantasy storybook art, soft hand-painted textures, rich strong colours, friendly-but-brave eyes, no scenery, no cartoon outlines, exactly one full-body creature per cell with an empty margin. TOP ROW = Bolt Kangaroo three times, a tan kangaroo with a long narrow kangaroo head, tall pointed ears, big strong back legs and a thick long tail. Top left STORYBOOK: natural kangaroo standing tall, NO glow, NO gear. Top middle ELEMENTAL: kangaroo with bright yellow lightning crackling down its legs and tail, NO gear. Top right CHAMPION: kangaroo with red boxing gloves, a leather chest strap and a gold champion belt, NO lightning. BOTTOM ROW: bottom left = Sunmane Lion CHAMPION: the golden lion from image 1 with its big shaggy mane and lion face, wearing gold and bronze armour plates and a royal blue cape. Bottom middle = Ruby Hummingbird ELEMENTAL: the tiny green and red hummingbird from image 1 with its long thin beak, hovering, wings glowing ruby red with light trails, no clothing. Bottom right = Sun Phoenix CHAMPION: a red and gold phoenix bird with long tail feathers wearing golden feather armour and a sun disc on its chest.
